_comment: Topics the AI writes original, reference/cheat-sheet-style LinkedIn posts about. Rotates through in order; cadenceHours controls how often a new draft is generated, checked on every cron tick.
topics: GRC frameworks and how they relate to each other (ISO 27001, NIST CSF, SOC 2)
IT risk management basics for people new to the field
common gaps in AML/BSA compliance programs
how to read a compliance audit finding
_cadence: 48h is roughly 3-4 posts a week. Lower it for more, raise it for fewer.
_lowStockThreshold: When unused briefs in topics/ fall to this number or below, check-brief-stock.mjs opens an issue (which emails you) asking for a restock. It closes itself once the folder is topped back up.
_attachCard: Generate a summary-card image from the brief's key points and attach it to the post. Set false for text-only. Only briefs get cards: without key points there is nothing checkable to put on one.
_cardFooter: The small grey line along the bottom of the card.
